files.scripts/rotate_app.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
log=$1
keep=$2
rm -f "$log.$keep"
i=$((keep - 1))
while [ "$i" -ge 1 ]; do
  if [ -f "$log.$i" ]; then mv "$log.$i" "$log.$((i + 1))"; fi
  i=$((i - 1))
done
mv "$log" "$log.1"
: > "$log"
